honors.title: Hack RU 2023 - Best Rutgers Hack Winner
honors.description:
Out of 250+ students and 40+ projects, my team and I created a middle man application between food pantries and Rutgers dining halls to generate recipes from unused ingredients at the end of the day. Utilized Python, TypeScript, and React.

- Won the award for best hack that benefits the Rutgers Student Association

honors.title: Hack RU 2022 - Maverick Track & Twilio Winner
honors.description:
Out of 200+ students and 30+ submitted projects, my team created a project that enabled students to play Wordle together and compare statistics. 

Won two awards:
- Maverick Track — Awarded for best hack outside of other tracks
- Twilio Award — Best & Most Unique Use of Twilio
